# Harbor documentation

Harbor deploys containers to your own servers or to Harbor Hosted, the managed
platform we run for you. You describe an app in `harbor.toml`, run
`harbor deploy`, and Harbor builds, ships and routes traffic to the new release.

- [Deploys](deploys.md): what happens when you run `harbor deploy`.
- [Networking](networking.md): domains, TLS and the IP allowlist.
- [Harbor Hosted](hosted/overview.md): plans, regions and limits.
